verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-configurable automations or agentic background workflows on impots.gouv.fr. The only related item is the option to choose automatic direct debit (prélèvement automatique) for CFE. That is a recurring payment method, an adjacent feature rather than automations a user sets up to run autonomously, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
